notes: Fixes a game added from a staff account's own desktop being unopenable by customers. A folder like C:\Users\Administrator is readable only by that Windows account, so the terminal was refused before the game was reached - and it reported this as the game being gone, which sent staff looking for a file that was still there. It now says the game cannot be opened on this computer, and the Games page warns about such a path as soon as it is added, naming the account and what to do. Browse and dropping a shortcut now also write the path using the variable for the folder it came from - %PUBLIC%\Desktop\... - so a game added once works in every Windows account and on every machine.
